import {spawn} from 'node:child_process';import {mkdir,writeFile} from 'node:fs/promises';import {createWriteStream} from 'node:fs';import {resolve} from 'node:path';
const label=process.argv[2];if(!/^[a-z0-9-]+$/.test(label))throw new Error('RUN_LABEL_REQUIRED');const dir=resolve('tests/fixtures/h4-016-f23',label);await mkdir(dir,{recursive:true});
const focused=['postgres-h4-015.test.ts','postgres-h4-016.test.ts','postgres-h4-016-migration.test.ts','postgres-h4-016-f23.test.ts','postgres-h4-016-f23-migration.test.ts'];
const commands=[['sha','git',['rev-parse','HEAD']],['postgres','pnpm',['test:postgres']],['health','node',['--test','tests/operations/supabase-health.test.mjs']],['diff-check','git',['diff','--check','32e85d1bc6631771f15c0a3817861a1ef3bef1e9','HEAD']]];
const results=[];for(const [id,cmd,args] of commands){const out=createWriteStream(resolve(dir,id+'.stdout.log')),err=createWriteStream(resolve(dir,id+'.stderr.log'));const result={id,cmd,args,started:new Date().toISOString(),status:null,signal:null,error:null};console.log('START',id);const child=spawn(cmd,args,{env:{...process.env,POSTGRES_H0_BIN:'/Users/andres/Applications/Postgres.app/Contents/Versions/17/bin',NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED:'1',H4012_CORRECTIVE44:'1',H4016_CORRECTIVE47:label.startsWith('repro')?'0':'1',H4014_CAPTURE_DIR:dir},stdio:['ignore','pipe','pipe']});child.stdout.pipe(out);child.stderr.pipe(err);child.on('error',e=>result.error=e.message);[result.status,result.signal]=await new Promise(r=>child.on('close',(status,signal)=>r([status,signal])));await Promise.all([new Promise(r=>out.writableFinished?r():out.on('finish',r)),new Promise(r=>err.writableFinished?r():err.on('finish',r))]);result.ended=new Date().toISOString();results.push(result);await writeFile(resolve(dir,id+'.status.json'),JSON.stringify(result,null,2)+'\n');await writeFile(resolve(dir,'results.json'),JSON.stringify(results,null,2)+'\n');console.log('END',id,result.status);if(result.status!==0){process.exitCode=1;break;}}
